title: Weinberg Capital Partners acquires niche perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange
summary: Niche perfume house Etat Libre d'Orange has been acquired by Weinberg Capital Partners, the independent investment firm that already owns Juliette Has A Gun, acquired in 2023. title: Competition: EU and UK fine leading fragrance firms for international cartel
summary: On Wednesday, November 25, the European Union and the United Kingdom, hit the biggest names in the global fragrance industry with fines totaling more than 570 million euros for taking part in an international fragrance cartel that might have forced consumers to pay more. Brussels imposed fines of EUR 471.9 million (USD 515 million), while Britain fined the companies GBP 85 million (EUR 101.5 million, or USD 111 million) in a parallel probe. title: Mielle expands into body care with Daily Glow collection for melanin-rich skin
summary: Mielle, the Black-founded beauty textured hair care brand acquired by Procter & Gamble in 2023, is entering the body care market with Daily Glow, its first-ever collection developed with the needs of melanin-rich skin in mind. Launched on Amazon during the week of November 23, 2026, the seven-product range targets uneven skin tone, texture and the appearance of dark spots.
